headline: Record Q2FY27 performance driven by broad-based growth

highlights: Daily Volume 4,06,407 Q2FY27 result is better than our estimate on all fronts ▪ Revenue was up 42.6% YoY and 18.6% QoQ to INR 21,893 Mn (vs CIE est. of INR 19,078 Mn) ▪ EBITDA was up 44.7% YoY and 21.6% QoQ to INR 2,574 Mn (vs CIE est. of INR 2,175 Mn).
Revenue growth significantly outpaced average industry performance, supported by a strong demand, customer additions, premiumisation and Minda VAST consolidation.
EBITDA margin improved 17 bps to 11.8%, while normalised PAT increased 69.1% to INR 1,431 Mn.

Strong order wins enhance medium-term growth visibility: MDA secured lifetime TFT instrument-cluster orders exceeding INR 10,000 Mn across 2W, 3W, CV and PV applications, with production planned from FY28E.
valuation: The company also won a 3.5 kW charger order valued at over INR 4,000 Mn, with SOP targeted for Q1FY28E, which is its first power-footprint order from an anchor PV customer.
View and Valuation: We marginally increase our FY27E EPS estimate, factoring in MDA’s stronger-than-expected Q2FY27 performance, while maintaining our FY28E estimate.
We value the company at 30x the average FY28E/FY29E EPS and reiterate our target price of INR 860, retaining our ‘BUY’ rating on the stock. 1 Choice Equity Broking Pvt.
